metric_definitions.decode_per_request_tps: Mean per-request decode rate, excluding prefill and including generation pauses. Historical rows use (completion_tokens - 1) / (last nonempty fragment - first nonempty fragment), except rows marked timing_source=engine. The 128 GiB Strata series preserves native client decode_tps (decode_rate_source=native_client); its token-count and timing convention differs slightly from the historical formula. The 128 GiB vLLM series preserves imported result rates (decode_rate_source=imported_result); do not treat all cohorts as recalculated with one uniform formula.
metric_definitions.common_decode_s: Intersection of all client decode intervals, separately for each measured batch. SSE fragments are not exact token counts; no aggregate token throughput is inferred.
metric_definitions.memory: DRAM: minimum host MemFree from saved snapshots, not process consumption or a continuous bound. VRAM: sampled GPU usage when available, otherwise engine-reported free VRAM. Missing samples remain null; bracketing-only samples are identified in run notes.
metric_definitions.engine_gpu_free_gib: Minimum engine.vram_free_mib across saved engine snapshots, converted to GiB; engine-reported headroom, not a measured workload peak
metric_definitions.occupied_memory: Displayed DRAM = hardware-profile total minus sampled MemFree, including OS and filesystem cache. Displayed VRAM = sampled_vram_used_gib when present, otherwise hardware-profile total minus engine_gpu_free_gib. Missing measurements remain unknown.
metric_definitions.sampled_vram_used_gib: Sampled occupied GPU memory in GiB; discrete observations, not a continuously measured peak.
